activity.notes: The Syrian National Congress proclaimed Faisal king of an independent Syria in March 1920. The short-lived Arab Kingdom of Syria ended when French forces occupied Damascus in July 1920. ATLAS records this Syrian kingship separately from Faisal's later 1921-1933 kingship of Iraq.

sources.title: Faysal I, King of Iraq — 1914-1918-Online
sources.citation_text: The International Encyclopedia of the First World War describes Faisal's Arab government in Damascus and the March 1920 proclamation of him as king of Syria, ending with the French occupation in July 1920.
